browser.title: Browser Driver
browser.description: Connect job boards and company career/ATS pages to Resumer via a Tampermonkey userscript: the AI reads JDs for match analysis and auto-fills lengthy application forms (extract form → map answers from resume & memory → fill field by field; submitting is always yours). All traffic stays on 127.0.0.1.
browser.listening: Local service running on port {port}, waiting for browser tabs
browser.noTabs: No connected tabs yet — install the script, then open Boss Zhipin / Liepin etc.
browser.notLoaded: Driver status unavailable (port may be in use).
browser.step1: Install the Tampermonkey extension in your browser
browser.step2: Copy the driver script below, then create a new script in Tampermonkey and paste it
browser.step3: Open a job site or career/ATS page (Boss/Liepin/Moka/Beisen/Workday etc. covered), then refresh here; for uncovered career sites add an @match line to the script
browser.copied: Script copied — paste it into Tampermonkey
browser.privacyNote: Safety: the AI only reads pages and fills forms; it never clicks send/submit/apply for you. Keep sensitive IDs manual. The script only runs on declared domains.

webSearch.title: Web search
webSearch.offHint: AI answers from local knowledge only.
webSearch.nativeHint: Use the model's own web grounding (Gemini / Claude; OpenAI-compatible varies — set Grok as your main model to enable its Live Search). Some Gemini versions reject mixing search with tools — switch to an engine mode if it errors.
webSearch.freeHint: Free DuckDuckGo search (no setup, may be rate-limited). The AI calls webSearch when it needs fresh info.
webSearch.bingHint: Bing web search (no setup; scrapes public results, may be rate-limited).
webSearch.googleHint: Google web search (no setup, but often blocked by anti-bot; switch to Bing / DuckDuckGo or Tavily if unstable).
webSearch.baiduHint: Baidu web search (no setup, better for Chinese results; may be blocked by anti-bot).
webSearch.tavilyHint: Tavily search API (higher quality; free key at tavily.com, stored locally only).
webSearch.grokHint: Use Grok (xAI) as a search backend: when the main model needs fresh info, Grok searches the web and summarizes in the background, then hands results + sources back. Set Base URL, model ID and API key (OpenAI format, stored locally only).
webSearch.settingsScopeHint: This only configures search-tool credentials. Whether to enable it and which mode to use is chosen separately in the Resume AI assistant and the Global Agent chat boxes — they don't affect each other.
webSearch.grokKeyRequired: Enter the Grok API key first
